author: Xuph
body:
Hello fellow minemans
i havent done a map like this in a long time. usually i dislike my own maps, though this map is really good imo. 
i had a lot of fun building this with my fellow buds, this map couldnt be completed without the help from the minemans:

- imryaan
- Legoche 
- Spoookeh
- Dereban

here are screenshots : http://imgur.com/a/kuBjB


since KoTH is a new gamemode and some players might be confused here is a video explaining the map and the gamemode in general, please watch it all in order to understand the map because from the screenshots its hard to understand: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cXfdGGfpxYo

the video explains everything from the different spawnpoints on koth maps, to the loadout, to how the map plays and basically everything you need to know.

dont give feedback if you havent watched the video because you will probably dont understand anything of how the map goes.

Proddyy_ helped me with the XML <3 and alexanderjoe10 hosted the server <3
Avicus XML will not be done since docs for this gamemode are not written yet. 

if this gamemode will ever turn competitive i want this to be a competitive map.
I do not give the download out because i do not want to.

leave your feedback below

replies.body: after watching the video i can tell that every aspect of this map was fully thought through. look forward to playing this

replies.author: Stimulating
replies.body:
Only issues for me is that points aren't hard to get onto as well, which doesn't reward coordinated pushes well and that you can't really come back from last the way the spawn is sorted. You can easily get choke-pointed if you lose a teamfight near 2nd or last. 

Other than that, well done. I really do like 5cp so yea.
